scope: Additive TH18 Ice Hound and Ice Pup parent-child baseline. Earlier frozen references are preserved unchanged.
game_version: The immutable source payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The current parent table was read from Goblins Farm client build 18.600.3 dated 2026-09-16. Supercell confirms the TH18 L8 addition on 2026-02-23. The Ice Pup range and cadence remain version-unknown secondary data.

sources.title: December Update 2020 recap
sources.limitations: The official launch post establishes Air Defense priority, ground-only single-target parent attacks, housing 40, speed 20, the slow qualitative behavior, the death freeze, Ice Pup spawning, and parent L5-L6 and Ice Pup HP/DPS tables. It does not publish the slow magnitude or duration, freeze radius, spawn geometry, Ice Pup cadence or range.

sources.title: Welcome to Let's Get Crafty Update
sources.limitations: The official balance note confirms the level-one death freeze change from 3.5 to 3.75 seconds. It does not publish all current freeze levels or a radius.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: The official TH18 release confirms Lava Hound and Ice Hound level 8. It does not publish the level-eight numerical table.

sources.title: Ice Hound
sources.limitations: The table reports L1-L8 parent HP and DPS plus housing, target type, cadence, range and speed from the stated client build. It does not report the death freeze, Pup count, slowdown, spawn geometry or projectile timing.

sources.title: Ice Hound and Ice Pup
sources.limitations: The tables report current L5-L8 parent Pup counts and freeze durations plus Ice Pup HP, DPS, damage per hit, range, cadence, speed and targeting. The pages do not identify a client build or exact timing, geometry, slow or collision contract.

target_focus.note: Core preserves the documented staged priority: Air Defenses, then remaining defenses, then ordinary buildings.

support.note: Core materializes the L5-L8 permanent parent baseline and spawns the sourced Ice Pup count. Slow and death freeze require values that remain unverified.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only parent inherited an any-target focus and had no spawned child lifecycle.
changed_values.replacement: Permanent L5-L8 parent levels materialize with the official Air Defense priority and spawn the secondary documented Ice Pup count on destruction. Ice Pup is a spawned-only Core entity.
changed_values.justification: Primary sources establish the parent-child ability and priority. A build-dated secondary parent table and a separately pinned secondary child observation supply missing current values without altering the historical payload.

known_uncertainties: Neither primary source publishes a freeze radius. Death freeze is not implemented rather than borrowing the Ice Golem radius.
The slow magnitude, duration, refresh and stacking rules for both parent and Ice Pup attacks are not published in the consulted sources. Slow is not implemented.

Spawn timing, individual coordinates, launch direction, child target inheritance, collision and visual launch are not published. Core queues all documented Pups at the destroyed parent position on the death tick in stable order.
The Ice Pup range and cadence are secondary version-unknown values. Its source image is not independently verified, so the Viewer must not present it as asset-complete.
Ice Hound levels 1-4 are temporary-event-only according to the secondary table and are not materialized by the permanent Core integration.
conclusion: Ice Hound L5-L8 and spawned Ice Pup L1 are shared Core, headless, Viewer and RL entities for their verified parent and child baseline. The increment remains partial until slow, freeze geometry, spawn geometry, projectile timing and verified assets are sourced.
